statement: Launch a standalone custom window from a definition, add a set of UI elements to it, and control title, size, position, transparency and parent-child relationships.

source.ref: Launch Window / Add Elements / Make Child Window / Create Transparent Window / Set Window Properties

superiority: Dino 8 should open native dockable windows in under 100 ms with persisted position per user and no dependency on a Windows-only presentation stack, so the same window works on every OS.

acceptance.corpus: Definition with 3 windows (one transparent, one child of another) opened and closed 100 times
acceptance.tolerance: No handle leak: managed memory growth < 5 MB after 100 cycles; window geometry restored within 1 px

acceptance.corpus: Cold launch of a 40-element window on reference hardware

statement: Create numeric and selection input controls (slider, multi-dimensional slider, range slider, toggle, checkbox, check list, radio button, pull-down, list box) whose values drive the parametric definition.

source.ref: Create Slider / Create MD Slider / Create Range Slider / Create Toggle / Create Check Box / Create Pull Down / Create List Box

superiority: Dino 8 should bind controls to definition inputs natively with keyboard access, screen-reader labels and live validation so users never need a separate add-on.

acceptance.corpus: One of each control type bound to 12 inputs, scripted drag of every slider across its domain
acceptance.tolerance: Emitted value equals control value within 1e-9; 0 missed updates in 1000 events

acceptance.corpus: Keyboard-only traversal of all controls in tab order
acceptance.tolerance: Every control reachable and operable; accessible name present on 100% of controls

statement: Create text-entry and display controls (text box, text block, label, markdown viewer, image, tooltip, separator) and update their content at run time from definition data.

source.ref: Create Text Box / Create Text Block / Create Label / Create Markdown Viewer / Create Image / Create Tooltip / Set Text Box

superiority: Dino 8 should render localized, right-to-left capable text with unicode and markdown support by default and expose the same API to scripts.

acceptance.corpus: Strings in English, Arabic, Japanese and emoji plus a 2 000-word markdown sample
acceptance.tolerance: Rendered without missing glyphs; text round-trips through get/set exactly (byte equal)

statement: Create action buttons, including true-only buttons, command buttons that run a named Rhino command, and pick buttons that let the user select Rhino geometry and return it to the definition.

source.ref: Create Button / Create True Only Button / Create Rhino Cmd Button / Create Rhino Pick Button

superiority: Dino 8 should make command and pick buttons first-class, with pick filters (type, layer, sub-element) and undo grouping, closing the sub-element picking gap users report.

acceptance.corpus: Pick button filtered to curves, then to sub-elements (polyline segment, solid edge) on a test file
acceptance.tolerance: Returned reference identifies the picked sub-element exactly in 100% of 50 trials

acceptance.corpus: Command button running a command, then undo
acceptance.tolerance: Single undo step restores prior state exactly

notes: Forum discussion records that the current plugin returns only the host object id when a sub-element is picked; Dino 8 should close this gap.

statement: Read the current state of any UI element and react to changes through a value listener that emits updated values and event triggers to the definition without polling.

source.ref: Value Listener / Get Element Properties / Window Status

superiority: Dino 8 should deliver change notifications through a deterministic event queue that coalesces bursts so the solver runs once per user gesture.

acceptance.corpus: Slider dragged through 500 positions in 1 s with a 20 ms solve
acceptance.tolerance: <= 1 solver run per animation frame; final value delivered exactly; no lost last event

statement: Arrange controls with layout containers (grid, simple grid, stack, wrap panel, border, scroll viewer, view box, expander, tab container) so a window can hold complex tool panels.

source.ref: Create Grid / Create Stack / Create Wrap Panel / Create Scroll Viewer / Create Expander / Tab Container

superiority: Dino 8 should reflow containers responsively at any DPI and window size with saved layouts, so panels never clip or need manual resizing.

acceptance.corpus: Nested container tree 6 levels deep with 200 controls resized from 400 to 1600 px and at 100/150/200 percent scale
acceptance.tolerance: No clipped or overlapping control; layout pass < 16 ms

statement: Show and edit tabular and picker data in a window: data table, file picker, color picker and gradient editor, with the table contents updatable from the definition.

source.ref: Create Data Table / Set Data Table / Create File Picker / Create Color Picker / Create Gradient Editor

superiority: Dino 8 should virtualize large tables so 100 000 rows scroll smoothly and support sort, filter and copy to spreadsheet natively.

acceptance.corpus: Table with 100 000 rows x 8 columns bound to a tree
acceptance.tolerance: Scroll at >= 30 fps; first paint <= 500 ms; sorted order matches a reference sort exactly

statement: Embed an interactive 3D viewport inside a custom window, display geometry (optionally textured) from the definition and set camera and display properties.

source.ref: Create 3D View / Set 3D View / Set 3D View Textured / Set 3D View Properties

superiority: Dino 8 should embed the real viewport engine (same display modes and materials as the main view) instead of a reduced preview, with orbit and pick support.

acceptance.corpus: 1 million-triangle mesh displayed in embedded view
acceptance.tolerance: >= 30 fps orbit on reference GPU; camera set/get round trip within 1e-6 units

statement: Create live charts and multi-series graphs inside a window and update their data and appearance from the definition.

source.ref: Create Chart / Create Multi Chart / Set Chart / Set Multi Chart / Set Chart Appearance

superiority: Dino 8 should offer GPU-drawn charts with zoom, hover value readout and export to image or CSV out of the box.

acceptance.corpus: Line, bar and pie charts with 10 000 points updated 30 times per second
acceptance.tolerance: Frame time <= 33 ms; plotted value of any point equals source within 1e-9; exported CSV equals source data

statement: Save and restore the state of all window elements as a snapshot, change element visibility, appearance and position at run time, and capture a window as an image.

source.ref: Save Element State / Restore Element State / Hide Show Element / Adjust Element Appearance / Adjust Element Positioning / Capture Window

superiority: Dino 8 should persist UI state with the model file and versions it so shared definitions open exactly as the author left them.

acceptance.corpus: Snapshot of 60 controls saved, defaults changed, then restored
acceptance.tolerance: All 60 values identical after restore (exact); captured PNG equals on-screen window pixel size

statement: Embed a web browser panel and a shape/drawing surface in a window, so a definition can show documentation pages and 2D vector graphics driven by data.

source.ref: Create Browser / Set Browser / Create Shape / Create Multi Shape / Set Shapes

superiority: Dino 8 should provide a sandboxed web panel and a retained-mode vector canvas so apps can show help and diagrams with no external runtime.

acceptance.corpus: Load a local HTML page and a 5 000-shape canvas updated each second
acceptance.tolerance: Page renders; script sandbox blocks file access outside the project; canvas update <= 50 ms
